convert_metashape_xml_to_krt_json: convert a Metashape cameras XML file to KRT JSON format using the CLI with input and output paths
extract_sensors_from_xml: extract sensor calibration data including intrinsics, distortion coefficients, and rig poses from a Metashape XML root element
extract_cameras_from_xml: extract all cameras from a Metashape XML root element and return them as a list of KRT-format dictionaries
compare_krt_dicts: compare two lists of KRT camera dictionaries for discrepancies in intrinsics, transforms, and distortion parameters
run_test_convert_cameras: test camera conversion by comparing the output of extract_cameras against a reference KRT JSON file in test_data
